premise: Rabbit's ears hear the rain long before anyone sees a cloud, and he gathers his friends under Mushroom just in time.
inspiration: Chicken Little (folk), turned: the warning is true, it is given calmly, and it brings everyone together instead of running around.
lesson: Listening carefully helps you look after others.
learning: Rabbits turn their long ears to hear sounds far away

en-US.title: Rabbit Hears the Rain
en-US.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 14s} It was a warm, sunny day, and {frog:enter} Frog came hopping to the pond. {frog:face happy} She sat very, very still. {frog:live} A little fly buzzed by… she watched it… SNAP! Gulp. She grinned. {rabbit:enter} Rabbit was munching in the meadow. Suddenly, {rabbit:live hold} his long ears shot straight up, and he listened, very still. [whispers] I can hear rain, he said. Far away. {sfx:far-rain solo} {frog:face surprised} Frog looked up. Not one cloud! But Rabbit's ears were turned towards the hills. It's coming, he said. {canvas:clouds 0.8 30s} And it was. Big grey clouds rolled in. [excited] Quick, under the {mushroom:enter} mushroom! {mushroom:face happy} {mushroom:pulse} {frog:go under mushroom} She spread her red cap wide, and slowly, slowly, {snail:enter} Snail crawled in too. {canvas:rain 0.7 20s} {sfx:rain-bed} Pitter-patter, down came the rain. {rabbit:live resume} Rabbit's ears came down, and he nibbled a clover leaf. {snail:live} Snail tucked into his shell… waited… then peeked out. Dry! {frog:face happy} {frog:hop} [happily] Thank you, Rabbit, said Frog. {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:hearts} Your ears are the best weather-watchers in the forest.

es-ES.title: Conejo oye la lluvia
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 14s} Era un día de sol calentito, y {frog:enter} Rana llegó saltando a la charca. {frog:face happy} Se quedó muy, muy quieta. {frog:live} Una mosquita pasó zumbando… Rana la miró… ¡ZAS! Glup. Y sonrió. {rabbit:enter} Conejo estaba en el prado, mordisqueando hierba. De pronto, {rabbit:live hold} sus orejas largas se levantaron bien tiesas, y escuchó, muy quieto. [whispers] Oigo lluvia, dijo. Muy lejos. {sfx:far-rain solo} {frog:face surprised} Rana miró arriba. ¡Ni una nube! Pero las orejas de Conejo apuntaban hacia las colinas. Ya viene, dijo. {canvas:clouds 0.8 30s} Y venía. Llegaron unas nubes grandes y grises. [excited] ¡Rápido, debajo de la {mushroom:enter} seta! {mushroom:face happy} {mushroom:pulse} {frog:go under mushroom} Ella abrió bien su sombrero rojo, y despacito, despacito, {snail:enter} Caracol se metió también. {canvas:rain 0.7 20s} {sfx:rain-bed} Plic, ploc, cayó la lluvia. {rabbit:live resume} Conejo bajó las orejas y mordisqueó un trébol. {snail:live} Caracol se escondió en su concha… esperó… y asomó. ¡Seco! {frog:face happy} {frog:hop} [happily] Gracias, Conejo, dijo Rana. {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:hearts} Tus orejas son las mejores para saber qué tiempo va a hacer.

far-rain.prompt: very faint rain far away across a valley, a soft distant hiss

rain-bed.prompt: gentle rain pattering on big leaves and a mushroom cap
